summary: IAM Security Audit (Iter 372) - 30/34 backend tests passed. Found 2 CRITICAL security bugs: (1) Guests can create tasks (should be 403), (2) Guests can create meetings (should be 403). Fixed 1 frontend bug: RoleDowngradeBanner was not showing due to PermissionsProvider calling API before user authenticated.

critical.issue: Guest role can create tasks - returns 200 instead of 403. Missing capability check for tasks.create
Guest role can create meetings - returns 200 instead of 403. Missing capability check for meetings.create

minor.issue: Endpoint path is /api/admin/audit/system not /api/admin/audit-log - test updated
Endpoint path is /api/news/posts not /api/news - test updated

ui_bugs.issue: Banner was not showing for downgraded users because PermissionsProvider was calling /user/permissions API before user was authenticated, causing AxiosError
ui_bugs.fix: Added useAuth() hook to PermissionsProvider to check if user is logged in before calling API

action_items: CRITICAL: Add capability check for tasks.create in POST /api/tasks endpoint - guests should get 403
CRITICAL: Add capability check for meetings.create in POST /api/meetings endpoint - guests should get 403
Verify the frontend fix for RoleDowngradeBanner is working correctly after restart
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/tasks in routes/tasks.py has no require_cap() check - any authenticated user can create tasks
POST /api/meetings in routes/meetings/core.py has no require_cap() check - any authenticated user can create meetings
Both endpoints should check for tasks.create and meetings.create capabilities respectively
PermissionsProvider was calling API on mount without checking if user was authenticated - fixed by adding useAuth() dependency
seed_data_creation: Used existing QA test accounts from iter372 setup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 372 IAM audit found 2 critical security bugs: guests can create tasks and meetings. The RoleDowngradeBanner frontend bug was fixed by adding useAuth() to PermissionsProvider. Main agent needs to add require_cap() checks to POST /api/tasks and POST /api/meetings endpoints.

tasks_meetings_guest_access.root_cause: POST /api/tasks and POST /api/meetings endpoints only call get_current_user() but do not check capabilities. Any authenticated user (including guests) can create tasks/meetings.
tasks_meetings_guest_access.reproduction: 1. Login as qa_guest@meetflow.com, 2. POST /api/tasks with {title:'test'}, 3. Observe 200 response instead of 403
tasks_meetings_guest_access.mitigation: Add 'await require_cap(user, "tasks.create", db)' after get_current_user() in create_task(). Same for meetings.create in create_meeting().

role_downgrade_banner_not_showing.root_cause: PermissionsProvider called /user/permissions API on component mount without checking if user was authenticated. This caused AxiosError before login, and the state was never updated after login.
role_downgrade_banner_not_showing.reproduction: 1. Open app, 2. Login as newguest_1776557090@example.com, 3. Observe banner not showing
role_downgrade_banner_not_showing.mitigation: Added useAuth() hook to PermissionsProvider and only call API when user is truthy. Fixed in /app/frontend/src/lib/permissions.js
